format: UCWDC Finals, look-ahead and look-behind tiebreakers

source.quote_free_summary: Still-tied contestants are compared column by column on marks right of the majority mark (look-ahead, smaller value ranks higher), then on marks left of it (look-behind).

requirement: A UCWDC engine must apply Rule #6 then Rule #7 in order.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A blocker to activating any future UCWDC scoring profile (OD-13). A future UCWDC engine must be independently verified, separately versioned (never by editing ordinal_rank@1 or studio_ordinal_majority@1) and evaluated under OD-24. Docs-only record: no compliance claimed.
interpretation_notes: Studio has no look-ahead or look-behind step. This is the difference shown by F-OM-09: Studio shares first place where Rule #6 separates the two entries.
decision_refs: OD-13 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: preserve DanceFlow Studio scoring; retrospective audit PR #795)
